import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem residue_power_minus_one_iff_odd (b m : ℕ) (hmod : b % 3 = 2) : (3 : ℤ) ∣ (b : ℤ) ^ m + 1 ↔ Odd m := by
  have h_odd_iff : ∀ k, Odd k ↔ k % 2 = 1 := by
    intro k
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨c, rfl⟩
      omega
    · intro hk
      exact ⟨k / 2, by omega⟩
  
  have h_pow : ∀ n, b ^ n % 3 = if n % 2 = 1 then 2 else 1 := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_mod, hmod, ih]
      have : n % 2 = 0 ∨ n % 2 = 1 := by omega
      rcases this with h0 | h1
      · have h_next : (n + 1) % 2 = 1 := by omega
        rw [if_neg (by omega), if_pos h_next]
      · have h_next : (n + 1) % 2 = 0 := by omega
        rw [if_pos h1, if_neg (by omega)]
  
  have h_dvd : 3 ∣ b ^ m + 1 ↔ Odd m := by
    rw [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero, Nat.add_mod, h_pow m, h_odd_iff]
    have : m % 2 = 0 ∨ m % 2 = 1 := by omega
    rcases this with h0 | h1
    · rw [if_neg (by omega)]
      simp [h0]
    · rw [if_pos h1]
      simp [h1]
  
  exact_mod_cast h_dvd

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem residue_power_minus_one_iff_odd (b m : ℕ) (hmod : b % 3 = 2) : (3 : ℤ) ∣ (b : ℤ) ^ m + 1 ↔ Odd m := by
  have hbNat : b = 3 * (b / 3) + 2 := by
    omega
  
  have hbz : (3 : ℤ) ∣ (b : ℤ) + 1 := by
    rw [hbNat]
    refine ⟨((b / 3 : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1, ?_⟩
    push_cast
    ring
  
  have hpow :
      ∀ n : ℕ, (3 : ℤ) ∣ (b : ℤ) ^ n - (-1 : ℤ) ^ n := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
        simp
    | succ n ih =>
        rw [pow_succ, pow_succ]
        have h₁ : (3 : ℤ) ∣ (b : ℤ) ^ n * ((b : ℤ) + 1) := by
          simpa [mul_comm] using
            (dvd_mul_of_dvd_left hbz ((b : ℤ) ^ n))
        have h₂ :
            (3 : ℤ) ∣ -((b : ℤ) ^ n - (-1 : ℤ) ^ n) := by
          exact dvd_neg.mpr ih
        have h₃ := dvd_add h₁ h₂
        convert h₃ using 1 <;> ring
  
  constructor
  · intro hdiv
    rcases even_or_odd m with he | ho
    · rcases he with ⟨k, hk⟩
      have hm : m = 2 * k := by
        omega
      rw [hm] at hdiv
      have hs : (-1 : ℤ) ^ (2 * k) = 1 := by
        simp [pow_mul]
      have hp := hpow (2 * k)
      have hp' : (3 : ℤ) ∣ (b : ℤ) ^ (2 * k) - 1 := by
        simpa [hs] using hp
      have hd : (3 : ℤ) ∣ 2 := by
        convert dvd_sub hdiv hp' using 1 <;> ring
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hd
      exfalso
      omega
    · exact ho
  · intro hm
    rcases hm with ⟨k, hk⟩
    have hm' : m = 2 * k + 1 := by
      omega
    rw [hm']
    have hs : (-1 : ℤ) ^ (2 * k + 1) = -1 := by
      simp [pow_add, pow_mul]
    have hp := hpow (2 * k + 1)
    simpa [hs] using hp
